models.prediction_model — Physics Models¶

The models.prediction_model module implements the three physics models that compute interaction parameters from amino acid sequences: Dimer_model, RPA_model, and FINCHES_model. Each model wraps a force field (from models.ff_models) and provides methods for both discrete sequence prediction and differentiable (continuous/probabilistic) prediction suitable for gradient-based optimization.

Module-Level Constants¶

models.prediction_model.kb¶

Boltzmann constant in kcal/mol/K (0.0019872041).

models.prediction_model.RES_ALPHA¶

The 23-character residue alphabet: "MGKTRADEYVLQWFSHNPCIXZB".

models.prediction_model.NUM_RESIDUES¶

Number of residue types (23).

Dimer Model¶

class models.prediction_model.Dimer_model(ff_type, pH_mode='normal')[source]¶

Bases: object

Second-virial-coefficient model for IDP interaction parameters.

Computes pairwise dimer-dimer interaction energies by numerically integrating the Mayer f-function over radial distance, then contracts the resulting 529x529 interaction tensor with dimer frequency vectors derived from probabilistic sequences.

Initialization

__init__(ff_type, pH_mode='normal')[source]¶

Initialize the dimer model with a specific force field.

Parameters:

  • ff_type – Force field identifier (e.g. ‘mpipi’, ‘calvados2’).

  • pH_mode – ‘normal’ or ‘pH’ for charge calculation.

Interaction Tensor Computation

calculate_aa_interactions(r, dr, kT, temp, salt_conc, pair_charges)¶

Compute the 23^2 x 23^2 dimer-dimer interaction energy tensor.

For each quadruplet of residue types (i,j,k,l), numerically integrates r^2 * (1 - exp(-alpha * sum_of_unbonded / kT)) over the radial grid to obtain the Mayer f-function integral.

Parameters:

  • r – Radial distance grid, shape (num_steps,).

  • dr – Grid spacing.

  • kT – Thermal energy (kb * temp).

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin.

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

  • pair_charges – Charge pairs, shape (529, 2).

Returns:

Interaction tensor of shape (23, 23, 23, 23).

set_aa_interactions(all_conditions, r0=0.01, r1=100.0, num_steps=100)¶

Precompute the 529x529 interaction tensor for each thermodynamic condition.

Parameters:

  • all_conditions – List of (temp, salt, pH) tuples.

  • r0 – Radial integration lower bound (Angstroms).

  • r1 – Radial integration upper bound (Angstroms).

  • num_steps – Number of radial grid points.

Returns:

Array of shape (N_conditions, 529, 529).

Sequence Transformations

pseq_to_dseq(pseq)¶

Convert a probabilistic sequence to dimer probability matrices.

Computes the outer product of adjacent residue distributions to obtain the probability of each dimer type at each position.

Parameters:

pseq – Probabilistic sequence, shape (L, 23).

Returns:

Dimer probabilities, shape (L-1, 23, 23).

Virial Coefficient Computation

dimer_virial_coefficients_internal(dseq1, dseq2, aa_interactions)¶

Compute the second virial coefficient from dimer frequency vectors.

Contracts the dimer frequency distributions of two sequences with the precomputed 529x529 interaction tensor to yield a scalar virial coefficient.

Parameters:

  • dseq1 – Dimer probabilities for sequence 1, shape (N1-1, 23, 23).

  • dseq2 – Dimer probabilities for sequence 2, shape (N2-1, 23, 23).

  • aa_interactions – Interaction tensor, shape (529, 529).

Returns:

Scalar virial coefficient B2.

pairwise_interaction_matrix_internal(dseq1, dseq2, aa_interactions)¶

dseq1: (N1-1, 23, 23) dimer probabilities for seq1 dseq2: (N2-1, 23, 23) dimer probabilities for seq2 aa_interactions: (529, 529) dimer–dimer interaction energies Returns: (N1, N2) residue–residue interaction matrix

RPA Model¶

class models.prediction_model.RPA_model(ff_type, pH_mode='normal', params=None)[source]¶

Bases: object

Random Phase Approximation model for effective chi parameters.

Combines mean-field (MFT), fluctuation (RPA), and short-range hydrophobic (chi_h) contributions to compute an effective Flory chi parameter for IDP pairs.

Initialization

__init__(ff_type, pH_mode='normal', params=None)[source]¶

Initialize the RPA model with a force field and physical parameters.

Parameters:

  • ff_type – Force field identifier.

  • pH_mode – ‘normal’ or ‘pH’ for charge calculation.

  • params – Dict with RPA parameters: rho0, lB, kappa, a, Vh0.

Setup

set_aa_interactions(N1, N2, pHs)[source]¶

Precompute residue separation matrices and per-pH charge vectors.

Parameters:

  • N1 – Length of sequence 1.

  • N2 – Length of sequence 2.

  • pHs – List of pH values.

Returns:

List of [res_diffs_array, all_charges_array].

Chi Components

calc_chi_eff_MFT(pseq1, pseq2, rho0, lB, kappa, charge)¶

Compute the mean-field theory electrostatic contribution to chi.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

  • rho0 – Reference density.

  • lB – Bjerrum length.

  • kappa – Inverse Debye length.

  • charge – Per-residue-type charges, shape (23,).

Returns:

Scalar mean-field chi contribution.

calc_chi_eff_RPA(pseq1, pseq2, rho0, lB, kappa, a, res_diffs, charge)¶

Compute the RPA fluctuation correction to chi.

Integrates the charge structure factor product over wavevector space, accounting for chain connectivity through the Gaussian connection tensor.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

  • rho0 – Reference density.

  • lB – Bjerrum length.

  • kappa – Inverse Debye length.

  • a – Smearing length scale.

  • res_diffs – [res_diffs_1, res_diffs_2] separation matrices.

  • charge – Per-residue-type charges, shape (23,).

Returns:

Scalar RPA chi contribution.

calc_chi_h(pseq1, pseq2, Vh0, rho0)¶

Compute the short-range hydrophobic contribution to chi.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

  • Vh0 – Hydrophobic interaction strength.

  • rho0 – Reference density.

Returns:

Scalar hydrophobic chi contribution.

calc_chi_eff(pseq1, pseq2, rho0, lB, kappa, a, Vh0, aa_interactions)¶

Compute the total effective chi as MFT + RPA + hydrophobic.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

  • rho0 – Reference density.

  • lB – Bjerrum length.

  • kappa – Inverse Debye length.

  • a – Smearing length scale.

  • Vh0 – Hydrophobic interaction strength.

  • aa_interactions – [res_diffs, all_charges] from set_aa_interactions.

Returns:

Array of effective chi values, one per pH condition.

FINCHES Model¶

class models.prediction_model.FINCHES_model(ff_type, pH_mode='normal', use_charge=True, use_aliphatic=True)[source]¶

Bases: object

FINCHES-style interaction parameter model.

Computes pairwise residue interaction energies with optional charge-context and aliphatic-cluster weighting corrections, then decomposes the interaction matrix into attractive/repulsive contributions relative to a null baseline.

Initialization

__init__(ff_type, pH_mode='normal', use_charge=True, use_aliphatic=True)[source]¶

Initialize the FINCHES model.

Parameters:

  • ff_type – Force field identifier.

  • pH_mode – ‘normal’ or ‘pH’ for charge calculation.

  • use_charge – If True, apply charge-context interaction weighting.

  • use_aliphatic – If True, apply aliphatic cluster weighting.

Setup

set_aa_interactions(all_conditions, r0=0.1, r1=30.0, num_steps=2991)¶

Precompute the 23x23 pairwise residue interaction matrix per condition.

Integrates unbonded potentials over [sigma, 3*sigma] for each residue-type pair, yielding a condition-dependent interaction matrix.

Parameters:

  • all_conditions – List of (temp, salt, pH) tuples.

  • r0 – Radial grid lower bound (Angstroms).

  • r1 – Radial grid upper bound (Angstroms).

  • num_steps – Number of radial grid points.

Returns:

Array of shape (N_conditions, 23, 23).

get_null_interaction_baseline(lower_end=-10.0, upper_end=10.0, alternative_sequence=None)[source]¶

Calibrate the null interaction baseline using a GS-repeat sequence.

Finds the baseline value such that a (GS)_200 sequence yields zero net interaction (root-finding on the interaction parameter).

Parameters:

  • lower_end – Lower bracket for root finding.

  • upper_end – Upper bracket for root finding.

  • alternative_sequence – Use this sequence instead of ‘GS’*200.

Aliphatic Weighting

get_aliphatic_residues(pseq)[source]¶

Compute per-position aliphatic probability from a probabilistic sequence.

Parameters:

pseq – Probabilistic sequence, shape (L, 23).

Returns:

Per-position aliphatic content, shape (L,).

build_gap_merged_fragments(ali_mask, max_separation=1)[source]¶

Identify contiguous aliphatic fragments, allowing small gaps.

Parameters:

  • ali_mask – Binary mask of aliphatic positions, shape (L,).

  • max_separation – Maximum number of non-aliphatic residues allowed within a fragment before splitting.

Returns:

List of (start, end) tuples for each merged fragment.

get_aliphatic_weighting(pseq, max_separation=1)[source]¶

Compute per-position aliphatic cluster strength.

Assigns each aliphatic position a windowed count (clipped to 3) reflecting the local density of aliphatic residues within its merged fragment.

Parameters:

  • pseq – Probabilistic sequence, shape (L, 23).

  • max_separation – Gap tolerance for fragment merging.

Returns:

Per-position cluster weights, shape (L,), values in [0, 3].

get_multiplier_weight_vectorized(w1, w2)[source]¶

Compute pairwise interaction multiplier from aliphatic cluster weights.

Maps the minimum of two cluster weights to a multiplier in [1, 3] with a linear-then-quadratic profile.

Parameters:

  • w1 – Cluster weights for sequence 1 (broadcastable).

  • w2 – Cluster weights for sequence 2 (broadcastable).

Returns:

Pairwise multiplier array.

get_aliphatic_interaction_weighting(pseq1, pseq2)[source]¶

Compute the L1 x L2 aliphatic interaction multiplier matrix.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

Returns:

Multiplier matrix, shape (L1, L2).

Charge Weighting

get_neighbors_window_of3(i, pseq)[source]¶

Extract a 3-residue window centered at position i (clamped at edges).

Parameters:

  • i – Center position index.

  • pseq – Probabilistic sequence, shape (L, 23).

Returns:

Window slice of pseq, shape (2 or 3, 23).

calculacte_FCR_NCPR(window)[source]¶

Compute fraction of charged residues and net charge per residue.

Parameters:

window – Slice of probabilistic sequence, shape (W, 23).

Returns:

Tuple of (FCR, NCPR) scalars.

get_charge_interaction_weighting(pseq1, pseq2)[source]¶

Compute an L1 x L2 charge-context weighting mask.

For each pair of charged residue positions, computes |NCPR/FCR| of their combined 3-residue windows to modulate the interaction.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

Returns:

Charge weighting matrix, shape (L1, L2).

Prediction Methods

return_interaction_parameters(seq1, seq2, aa_interactions=None, null_interaction_baseline=None, use_charge=None, use_aliphatic=None)[source]¶

Compute FINCHES interaction parameters from sequence strings.

Builds the pairwise interaction matrix W, applies charge and aliphatic weightings, then decomposes into attractive/repulsive components relative to the null baseline.

Parameters:

  • seq1 – First amino acid sequence string.

  • seq2 – Second amino acid sequence string.

  • aa_interactions – Precomputed 23x23 matrices. If None, uses stored values.

  • null_interaction_baseline – Override the calibrated baseline.

  • use_charge – Override the charge weighting flag.

  • use_aliphatic – Override the aliphatic weighting flag.

Returns:

Array of epsilon values, one per condition.

return_interaction_parameters_pseqs(pseq1, pseq2, aa_interactions, null_interaction_baseline=None, use_charge=None, use_aliphatic=None)[source]¶

Compute FINCHES interaction parameters from probabilistic sequences.

Same as return_interaction_parameters but operates on pseq arrays directly. Not JIT-compiled due to Python-level branching in the charge and aliphatic weighting logic.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

  • aa_interactions – Precomputed 23x23 matrices per condition.

  • null_interaction_baseline – Override the calibrated baseline.

  • use_charge – Override the charge weighting flag.

  • use_aliphatic – Override the aliphatic weighting flag.

Returns:

Array of epsilon values, one per condition.

get_charge_interaction_weighting(pseq1, pseq2)[source]¶

Compute an L1 x L2 charge-context weighting mask.

For each pair of charged residue positions, computes |NCPR/FCR| of their combined 3-residue windows to modulate the interaction.

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

Charge weighting matrix, shape (L1, L2).

get_null_interaction_baseline(lower_end=-10.0, upper_end=10.0, alternative_sequence=None)[source]¶

Calibrate the null interaction baseline using a GS-repeat sequence.

Finds the baseline value such that a (GS)_200 sequence yields zero net interaction (root-finding on the interaction parameter).

Parameters:

  • lower_end – Lower bracket for root finding.

  • upper_end – Upper bracket for root finding.

  • alternative_sequence – Use this sequence instead of ‘GS’*200.

set_aa_interactions(all_conditions, r0=0.1, r1=30.0, num_steps=2991)¶

Precompute the 23x23 pairwise residue interaction matrix per condition.

Integrates unbonded potentials over [sigma, 3*sigma] for each residue-type pair, yielding a condition-dependent interaction matrix.

Parameters:

  • all_conditions – List of (temp, salt, pH) tuples.

  • r0 – Radial grid lower bound (Angstroms).

  • r1 – Radial grid upper bound (Angstroms).

  • num_steps – Number of radial grid points.

Returns:

Array of shape (N_conditions, 23, 23).

return_interaction_parameters(seq1, seq2, aa_interactions=None, null_interaction_baseline=None, use_charge=None, use_aliphatic=None)[source]¶

Compute FINCHES interaction parameters from sequence strings.

Builds the pairwise interaction matrix W, applies charge and aliphatic weightings, then decomposes into attractive/repulsive components relative to the null baseline.

Parameters:

  • seq1 – First amino acid sequence string.

  • seq2 – Second amino acid sequence string.

  • aa_interactions – Precomputed 23x23 matrices. If None, uses stored values.

  • null_interaction_baseline – Override the calibrated baseline.

  • use_charge – Override the charge weighting flag.

  • use_aliphatic – Override the aliphatic weighting flag.

Returns:

Array of epsilon values, one per condition.

return_interaction_parameters_pseqs(pseq1, pseq2, aa_interactions, null_interaction_baseline=None, use_charge=None, use_aliphatic=None)[source]¶

Compute FINCHES interaction parameters from probabilistic sequences.

Same as return_interaction_parameters but operates on pseq arrays directly. Not JIT-compiled due to Python-level branching in the charge and aliphatic weighting logic.

Parameters:

  • pseq1 – Probabilistic sequence 1, shape (L1, 23).

  • pseq2 – Probabilistic sequence 2, shape (L2, 23).

  • aa_interactions – Precomputed 23x23 matrices per condition.

  • null_interaction_baseline – Override the calibrated baseline.

  • use_charge – Override the charge weighting flag.

  • use_aliphatic – Override the aliphatic weighting flag.

Returns:

Array of epsilon values, one per condition.
